notes.title: Gorgeous fantasy RPG Elflock looks primed to fill The Witcher 4 void
notes.content:
All the best fantasy games come from folklore and fairy tales in my opinion, and Elflock looks like it'll be no exception. In a world inspired by Hungarian folklore and medieval European traditions, a young princess is called upon to save her homeland after a foreign empire threatens war - and it's giving me major The Witcher vibes, just minus the monster hunting.
